_metadata.description: Oshkosh HEMTT A4 M977A4 8x8 cargo truck (2015 product sheet). Air-sprung beam axles on all four axles, steered front tandem, bogie-centre wheelbase. Headline dimensions, weights, tyres, suspension models and powertrain are published; individual axle spacings are measured from the sheet's to-scale drawing; everything else is estimated.
_metadata.author: RFloEng

data_origin.detail: Published (Oshkosh product sheet): wheelbase 210 in, track 79 in, length/width/height, curb weight, GVWR (standard/armoured), GCWR, payload, tyre size and count, NEWAY ADS-240/AD-246 air suspension with 4 height control valves, axle models, steering on front tandem, engine, transmission and transfer case models, fuel capacity, speed, fording. Measured from drawing (estimate, about ±30 mm): axle spreads 1525 / 1490 mm, scaled to the published wheelbase. Estimated (_est): hardpoints, CG, masses split, spring/damper rates, torque curve, gear and axle ratios, axle ratings, tyre overall diameter.
